nodes.title: MobileApp / WebApp / AdminDashboard
nodes.detail: Independent customer and staff applications; each connects to its scoped API boundary.

nodes.title: Customer API and staff API boundaries
nodes.detail: Separate sessions, audiences and permissions; no client is a wallet or provider-secret authority.

nodes.title: APIbackend | Go / chi domain engine
nodes.detail: One customer-wallet subledger; atomic holds, balanced journals, policies and audit.

nodes.title: PostgreSQL and durable workers
nodes.detail: Commit financial intent and outbox together; recover jobs without another financial effect.

nodes.title: QPay API | server-to-server execution
nodes.detail: Persist the selected upstream reference; query ambiguous requests instead of resubmitting.

nodes.title: Financial partners and reconciliation
nodes.detail: Contracted custody / rails; compare product, upstream and settlement evidence.

nodes.title: Authenticate, authorise and validate
nodes.detail: Separate audiences; customer ownership, KYC/risk limits and transaction-bound approval.

nodes.title: Create or recover the original intent
nodes.detail: Scope the idempotency key and fingerprint; changed financial details cause a conflict.

nodes.title: Reserve funds and enqueue atomically
nodes.detail: PostgreSQL transaction, ordered locks, uniqueness and durable outbox; never cache authority.

nodes.title: Submit through the selected QPay route
nodes.detail: Persist the upstream reference. Timeout remains unresolved, not failure or refund proof.

nodes.title: Verify observations and reconcile
nodes.detail: Authenticated deduplicated callbacks or original-reference queries; record late outcomes.

nodes.title: Post final journals and expose status
nodes.detail: Immutable balanced entries; separate payment, settlement, fulfilment and delivery states.

mobileapp.title: MobileApp | Customer journey and safe recovery

nodes.title: Secure authentication shell
nodes.detail: Native registration, verification, MFA/recovery and session controls; no dashboard chrome.

nodes.title: Eligibility, wallet and funding
nodes.detail: Read authoritative account/tier state; show available versus held funds.

nodes.title: Transfer or bill selection
nodes.detail: Recipient / biller validation and server-issued quote; no offline money execution.

nodes.title: Review and approve bound details
nodes.detail: Show amount, fee, currency and recipient; changes require fresh authorization.

nodes.title: Recover accepted or pending intent
nodes.detail: Application restart or weak connection retrieves the existing operation, not a new payment.

nodes.title: Receipts, fulfilment and support
nodes.detail: Display server-confirmed outcome; tokens, notifications and cases have their own lifecycle.

nodes.title: Independent staff authentication
nodes.detail: MFA, scoped roles and short-lived privileged authorization; never a customer session.

nodes.title: Investigate scoped evidence
nodes.detail: KYC, customer cases, payment timeline, provider observations and reconciliation breaks.

nodes.title: Propose a controlled action
nodes.detail: Document reason, supporting evidence, financial scope and policy version.

nodes.title: Independent review and approval
nodes.detail: Different identities; no self-approval, silent balance edits or reused changed approval.

nodes.title: APIbackend executes authorised change
nodes.detail: Compensating journals for corrections; permanent audit history and verified upstream action.

nodes.title: Review result and unresolved work
nodes.detail: Track acceptance, settlement, case resolution and aged exceptions without fabricated metrics.

nodes.title: Separate customer authentication shell
nodes.detail: Register, verify, recover and manage sessions through the reviewed API security boundary.

nodes.title: Responsive wallet and activity
nodes.detail: Authoritative balances, held funds, account eligibility and scoped history.

nodes.title: Prepare transfer or bill purchase
nodes.detail: Validate recipient/customer reference and fetch current server quote and limits.

nodes.title: Confirm transaction details
nodes.detail: Bind payer, recipient, amount, currency, fees, version and expiry to authorization.

nodes.title: Resume the original operation
nodes.detail: Refresh and network recovery query pending intent; prevent accidental duplicate submission.

nodes.title: Serve evidence and aftercare
nodes.detail: Final receipts, statements, bill value, notifications and transaction-linked support.
